skills.name: cleanTranscript
skills.card:
cleanTranscript — Strip the timestamps, cue numbers and repeated speaker labels out of an auto-generated transcript, rejoin the sentences its captions cut in half, and drop the stutters and filler words.
  needs: text: string
  optional: removeFillers: boolean, removeStutters: boolean
  e.g. "strip the timestamps out of this transcript" → {"text":"[0:00:00 --> 0:00:05] Today we look at the tariffs and how they\n\n[0:00:05 --> 0:00:10] impact the industry. Let us jump in."}

text.label: transcript
text.prompt: Paste the transcript and I will tidy it.

removeFillers.label: remove filler words
removeFillers.description: drop "you know" and "kind of" where they are clearly filler

removeStutters.label: remove stutters
removeStutters.description: drop a repeated word the speaker restarted on

examples: strip the timestamps out of this transcript
clean up this auto generated transcript
tidy this srt subtitle file into readable text
remove the filler words from this transcript
take the repeated speaker names out of this recording transcript
